note: Commerce Abandoned Carts sends reminder emails for abandoned Drupal Commerce draft orders from hook_cron(), via commerce.mail_handler, tracking sent orders in the commerce_abandoned_carts DB table. All behaviour is in the config object commerce_abandoned_carts.settings (keys: timeout=1440, history_limit=21600, batch_limit=5, from_email, from_name='', subject='Your order is incomplete.', customer_service_phone_number='', bcc_active=false, bcc_email, testmode=true, testmode_email). Config form route commerce_abandoned_carts.configuration (/admin/commerce/config/abandoned_carts), permission 'administer commerce abandoned carts'. Test mode is ON by default. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config object.

evals.prompt: How does the commerce_abandoned_carts module actually send its abandoned-cart reminder emails? What triggers the send, and which orders does it target?
evals.expected_output: Sending happens in hook_cron() (commerce_abandoned_carts_cron). On each cron run it finds draft commerce orders with a customer email that have been idle longer than the timeout (but within the history limit) and not yet notified, then sends via commerce.mail_handler. There is no manual send button.

evals.prompt: I installed commerce_abandoned_carts but no customers are getting emails. It ships in a safe default state. What setting controls this and what do I change to actually send to customers?
evals.expected_output: Test mode is ON by default (testmode: true), which routes every message to testmode_email and never marks orders as sent. Turn testmode off (0) in commerce_abandoned_carts.settings (Commerce > Configuration > Abandoned carts) to send to real customers.

evals.prompt: Where is the commerce_abandoned_carts configuration form, and which permission and config object back it?
evals.expected_output: Form at /admin/commerce/config/abandoned_carts (route commerce_abandoned_carts.configuration), permission 'administer commerce abandoned carts', config object commerce_abandoned_carts.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the commerce_abandoned_carts configuration and report the current 'Send timeout' value (in minutes).
Inspect the live commerce_abandoned_carts settings on this site and report the configured 'From name' used on reminder emails.
Configure commerce_abandoned_carts on this site to go live: set the send timeout to 4320 minutes and turn test mode OFF. Apply the changes to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: In commerce_abandoned_carts.settings set timeout=4320 and testmode=false (e.g. drush cset commerce_abandoned_carts.settings timeout 4320; drush cset commerce_abandoned_carts.settings testmode 0).

evals.prompt: I want a copy of every abandoned-cart reminder sent to ops@example.com for monitoring, using the commerce_abandoned_carts module. Turn that on for me on this site.
evals.expected_output: Enable BCC in commerce_abandoned_carts.settings: set bcc_active=true and bcc_email='ops@example.com' (e.g. drush cset commerce_abandoned_carts.settings bcc_active 1; drush cset commerce_abandoned_carts.settings bcc_email ops@example.com).
